name: Improved Einhander (Combat)
body:
A formidable blade makes for a formidable opponent.

Prerequisite(s): Einhander feat, Character 7th level

Benefit(s): As long as you are only wielding a single, light or one-handed weapon in one hand and no other weapons or shields in your off-hand(s), you may add your half of the total of your enhancement bonuses (to include weapon special properties) of your weapon to your armor class as a dodge bonus (minimum 1). For example, a +2 icy burst would have a total of +4, granting you a +2 dodge bonus to AC.
